title: Receivables Aging
description: Open invoices bucketed by days late, an aging pivot by customer that collectors can filter, and a doughnut of what is overdue.
developerHook: Compute the business rules in TypeScript, then hand Excel a pivot readers can slice themselves.

preview.playgroundSummary: 64 open invoices with days late and buckets computed in TypeScript, an aging pivot by customer filtered by collector, and a doughnut of receivables by age.
